summary: Implementable specs for the Volume agent family (6 subagents) for an NSE F&O 5-minute mean-reversion signal system on Finvasia Shoonya data: pcr (writer-dominated Indian PCR from the monthly stock option chain, mild contrarian, stock-adjusted bands shifted below index bands), orderflow (tbq/tsq + top-5 depth pressure ratio with spoof/staleness guards, refreshed via GetQuotes), vwap (session VWAP from 5m candles cross-checked against the `ap` touchline field, z-score distance + slope scoring tuned for mean-reversion entries), rel_volume (time-of-day-adjusted relative volume vs 10-session same-slot medians, bar + cumulative blend), futures_oi_regime (4-quadrant long/short buildup classification from stock futures price+OI daily and intraday deltas with expiry-week discounting), and volume_profile (FUTURE stub returning neutral 50). Every spec gives exact formulas, parameter defaults, Shoonya field mappings, fallbacks when data is unavailable, and 0-100 BUY/SELL score logic computable in <1s from cached data.

algorithms.name: Put-Call Ratio (monthly stock option chain)
algorithms.inputs: Option chain snapshot for the CURRENT monthly expiry, supplied with the signal: for each strike i within the band: ce_oi[i], pe_oi[i] (open interest in shares), ce_vol[i], pe_vol[i] (day volume). Also: underlying LTP (cash `lp`), days_to_expiry (trading days), strike_step (from chain).
algorithms.steps:
1. ATM = strike in chain closest to underlying lp.
2. Select strikes with |strike - lp| / lp <= band_pct (default 0.10, i.e. +-10% of spot), capped at strikes_each_side=10 per side of ATM. Ignore rows with ce_oi+pe_oi == 0.
3. PCR_OI = sum(pe_oi) / sum(ce_oi). If sum(ce_oi) == 0 -> mark oi_unavailable.
4. PCR_VOL = sum(pe_vol) / sum(ce_vol). If sum(ce_vol) == 0 -> mark vol_unavailable.
5. Liquidity gate: if sum(ce_oi)+sum(pe_oi) < min_chain_oi (default 25000 shares) treat chain as illiquid -> return 50/50 with flag 'illiquid_chain'.
6. Interpretation (India, writer-dominated OI — verified: index neutral band 0.8-1.2, extremes ~0.7/1.3; SINGLE STOCKS run structurally lower because Indian stock chains are call-heavy, so bands are shifted down): high stock PCR_OI (>~1.0) = heavy put writing / crowd hedged = support below = bullish lean; low PCR_OI (<~0.4) = call writers capping upside = bearish lean. This is a MILD contrarian/positioning context, never a trigger — scores are deliberately compressed to [20,80].
7. score_oi_buy = piecewise-linear interpolation of PCR_OI over points (0.30 -> 20), (0.60 -> 50), (1.20 -> 80); clamp to [20,80]. (0.60 ~ single-stock neutral midpoint, vs 1.0 for indices.)
8. score_vol_buy = piecewise-linear of PCR_VOL over (0.30 -> 35), (0.60 -> 50), (1.50 -> 65); clamp [35,65] (volume PCR is same-day flow, noisier — compressed harder).
9. buy_raw = w_oi*score_oi_buy + w_vol*score_vol_buy (w_oi=0.7, w_vol=0.3). If one variant unavailable use the other alone; if both unavailable return 50/50.
10. Expiry decay guard: if days_to_expiry <= expiry_guard_days (default 2), OI is dominated by unwinding/rollover -> buy = 50 + (buy_raw-50)*0.5; else buy = buy_raw.
11. sell = 100 - buy. Round both to int.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: buy = clamp(0.7*interp(PCR_OI; 0.30->20, 0.60->50, 1.20->80) + 0.3*interp(PCR_VOL; 0.30->35, 0.60->50, 1.50->65), 20, 80); halved distance from 50 if days_to_expiry<=2; 50 if chain illiquid/unavailable. High PCR (put writing = support) supports BUY.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: sell = 100 - buy. Low PCR (call-writing cap, call-heavy crowd) supports SELL symmetrically.
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.15, sell 0.15 — slow-moving positioning context; single-stock PCR is thin and event-driven so it should tilt, not decide.
algorithms.data_requirements: GetOptionChain(exch='NFO', tsym=<monthly ATM option tsym>, strprc=str(ATM), cnt=10) to get the strike ladder, then GetQuotes(exch='NFO', token=t) per strike for `oi` and `v` (volume). This snapshot is fetched by the orchestrator when the signal fires (parallelize the ~40 GetQuotes calls, cache TTL 300s); the agent itself only computes from the cached snapshot so it stays <1s. No greeks needed. If the chain fetch fails or the stock has no options, return 50/50 with flag 'no_chain'. params: band_pct=0.10, strikes_each_side=10, w_oi=0.7, w_vol=0.3, oi_points=[(0.30,20),(0.60,50),(1.20,80)], vol_points=[(0.30,35),(0.60,50),(1.50,65)], min_chain_oi=25000, expiry_guard_days=2, expiry_shrink=0.5.

algorithms.name: Order-book Pressure (pending-quantity imbalance)
algorithms.inputs: From a FRESH GetQuotes(exch='NSE', token=<cash token>) at signal time: tbq (total pending buy qty), tsq (total pending sell qty), bq1..bq5, sq1..sq5 (5-level bid/ask sizes), bp1, sp1 (best bid/ask), lp, uc, lc (circuit limits), ltq. Plus the most recent cached websocket touchline/depth values of tbq/tsq (age <= 60s) for a persistence check.
algorithms.steps:
1. At signal time issue one GetQuotes REST call (~100-300ms) — do NOT rely on a stale cache for this agent.
2. PR = tbq / (tbq + tsq). If tbq+tsq == 0 -> PR = 0.5.
3. TI = sum(bq1..bq5) / (sum(bq1..bq5) + sum(sq1..sq5)); denominator 0 -> 0.5.
4. raw = w_total*PR + w_top5*TI (w_total=0.6, w_top5=0.4).
5. Persistence/anti-spoof check: PR_ws = cached websocket tbq/(tbq+tsq) (age<=60s). If available and |PR - PR_ws| > spoof_delta (default 0.15), the book flipped within a minute — likely layering/cancellation noise -> confidence = 0.5 else 1.0. If no cached value, confidence = 1.0.
6. Liquidity guard: spread_bps = (sp1 - bp1)/((sp1+bp1)/2)*10000. If spread_bps > max_spread_bps (default 30) -> confidence *= 0.5.
7. Circuit guard: if lp >= lc*1.005 is false or lp <= uc*0.995 is false (i.e. lp within 0.5% of uc or lc) -> return 50/50 flag 'near_circuit' (one-sided frozen book, ratio meaningless).
8. buy_full = clamp(50 + (raw - 0.5)*250, 0, 100) (raw 0.30 -> 0, 0.50 -> 50, 0.70 -> 100; NSE cash imbalance rarely leaves 0.35-0.65, so slope 250 uses the realistic range).
9. buy = 50 + (buy_full - 50)*confidence; sell = 100 - buy.
KNOWN LIMITATIONS (document in code): tbq/tsq are PENDING limit orders, not executed flow — spoofable (large orders parked then cancelled), blind to icebergs and market orders, and biased in trends (passive buyers rest lower as price falls, inflating tbq exactly when price is weak). At circuit locks the imbalance is real but untradeable. This agent is short-horizon context only.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: buy = 50 + (clamp(50 + (0.6*PR + 0.4*TI - 0.5)*250, 0, 100) - 50) * confidence, where confidence in {1.0, 0.5, 0.25} from the persistence and spread guards multiplying; 50 if near circuit. PR>0.5 (more pending buy qty) supports BUY.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: sell = 100 - buy; PR<0.5 (ask-side dominance) supports SELL.
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.15, sell 0.15 — cheapest signal to compute but the most gameable (pending orders != trades); keep low.
algorithms.data_requirements: GetQuotes REST on the CASH token at signal time: fields tbq, tsq, bq1-5, sq1-5, bp1, sp1, lp, uc, lc. Websocket depth subscription ('d' touchline) supplies the cached comparison tbq/tsq; if only plain touchline is subscribed, skip the persistence check (confidence=1.0). If GetQuotes fails, fall back to last websocket depth snapshot if age<=15s, else return 50/50 flag 'stale'. params: w_total=0.6, w_top5=0.4, slope=250, spoof_delta=0.15, ws_max_age_s=60, max_spread_bps=30, circuit_buffer_pct=0.5.

algorithms.name: Session VWAP distance and slope
algorithms.inputs: Today's 5m candles from 09:15 IST (TPSeries: inth, intl, intc, intv per bar), current lp, GetQuotes/touchline `ap` (day average traded price = exchange session VWAP) if available, ATR14 on 5m (computed from the supplied 200+ bar history).
algorithms.steps:
1. For each completed bar i today: tp_i = (inth_i + intl_i + intc_i)/3, v_i = intv_i.
2. VWAP = sum(tp_i*v_i)/sum(v_i). Cross-check: if `ap` from GetQuotes/touchline is available and >0, use VWAP = ap (exchange-computed, authoritative) and keep the candle-computed series only for the slope; do NOT use TPSeries `intvwap` as session VWAP without verifying per-broker semantics (it is interval-scoped in practice) — the tp*v cumulative sum is the safe default.
3. Volume-weighted sd: sd = sqrt(sum(v_i*(tp_i - VWAP)^2)/sum(v_i)). Stability floor: sd = max(sd, 0.25*ATR14_5m, 0.0005*VWAP).
4. z = (lp - VWAP)/sd.
5. Slope: let VWAP_k = cumulative VWAP recomputed as of bar k. slope_pct = (VWAP_now - VWAP_{now-K})/VWAP_{now-K}*100 with K=6 bars (30 min). If fewer than K+1 bars today, use all available (min 3). Classify: UP if slope_pct >= flat_thr (default 0.10), DOWN if <= -flat_thr, else FLAT.
6. Base scores (mean-reversion logic: buying far BELOW a flat/rising VWAP = discount = good; buying above = chasing):
   buy_base = clamp(50 - 20*z, 5, 95); sell_base = clamp(50 + 20*z, 5, 95).
7. Falling-knife / blowoff cap: if z < -3 -> buy_base = min(buy_base, 60) (stretch that deep usually means regime break, not a dip); if z > +3 -> sell_base = min(sell_base, 60).
8. Slope adjust: BUY: +10 if UP, 0 if FLAT, -15 if DOWN. SELL: +10 if DOWN, 0 if FLAT, -15 if UP. Clamp [0,100].
9. Early-session guard: if completed bars today < min_bars (default 6, i.e. before ~09:45), score = 50 + (score-50)*0.5.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: buy = clamp( clamp(50 - 20*z, 5, 95) [capped at 60 if z<-3] + slope_adj_buy(+10 up / 0 flat / -15 down), 0, 100 ), halved distance from 50 before 6 bars. z=-1 -> ~70, z=-2 -> ~90 (capped by knife rule below -3); z=+1 -> ~30 (chasing).
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Mirror: sell = clamp( clamp(50 + 20*z, 5, 95) [capped at 60 if z>+3] + slope_adj_sell(+10 down / 0 flat / -15 up), 0, 100 ), same early-session shrink.
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.25, sell 0.25 — most directly aligned with the mean-reversion entry logic and built from the most reliable data (own candles).
algorithms.data_requirements: TPSeries(exch='NSE', token=<cash>, interval=5) today's bars — already in the signal's candle history; `ap` and `lp` from cached websocket touchline or the GetQuotes call made for orderflow (reuse it, zero extra latency). If `ap` missing, candle-computed VWAP is fully sufficient. If total session volume is 0 (halted stock) return 50/50 flag 'no_volume'. params: K_slope=6, flat_thr=0.10 (% per 30min), z_slope=20, knife_z=3.0, knife_cap=60, slope_bonus=+10, slope_penalty=-15, min_bars=6, sd_floor=max(0.25*ATR14, 5bps of VWAP).

algorithms.name: Relative Volume (time-of-day adjusted)
algorithms.inputs: 5m candles (intv) for today plus the past N=10 trading sessions for the cash series; current IST time; last completed bar volume.
algorithms.steps:
1. Maintain a rolling cache of 15 calendar days of 5m candles per symbol (refresh once daily pre-open via TPSeries; the 200-bar signal payload only covers ~2.7 sessions of NSE's 75 bars/day, so this agent needs its own daily-cached history).
2. Bucket every bar by its IST start time slot k in {09:15, 09:20, ..., 15:25} (75 slots).
3. For each slot k: base_bar[k] = median over the last N=10 sessions of v_{s,k} (median, not mean — robust to one-off event spikes). base_cum[k] = median over sessions of cumsum(v_s)[k].
4. Let k* = slot of the LAST COMPLETED bar (never the forming bar — it is partial). RVOL_bar = v_today[k*] / base_bar[k*]. If base_bar[k*] == 0, substitute base_bar[k*] = mean of base_bar over all slots; if still 0 -> return 50/50 flag 'no_history'.
5. RVOL_cum = cumsum(v_today)[k*] / base_cum[k*] (same zero-guard).
6. RVOL = w_bar*RVOL_bar + w_cum*RVOL_cum (w_bar=0.6 — the surge at the trigger bar is the conviction signal; w_cum=0.4 stabilizes it).
7. Session-count guard: if available sessions < min_sessions (default 5), score = 50 + (score-50)*0.6.
8. Map RVOL to score with piecewise-linear interpolation over points: (0.0 -> 25), (0.5 -> 25), (0.8 -> 45), (1.2 -> 55), (2.0 -> 75), (4.0 -> 90), (inf -> 90). Volume surge = conviction for WHICHEVER direction the trigger fired, so BUY and SELL use the same map. Dead tape (RVOL<0.5) means the trigger is statistically unreliable -> 25.
9. Caveat (comment in code): >4x spikes are often news events where mean-reversion logic breaks; the cap at 90 (not 100) plus the event-risk agent elsewhere handles this — do not extrapolate above 4x.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: buy = interp(RVOL; 0.5->25, 0.8->45, 1.2->55, 2.0->75, 4.0->90), clamped [25,90], shrunk toward 50 by 40% if <5 history sessions. Direction-agnostic: surge confirms conviction.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: sell = identical function of RVOL (volume confirms the SELL trigger the same way it confirms BUY).
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.25, sell 0.25 — the cleanest conviction/participation measure available from Shoonya and immune to book-spoofing.
algorithms.data_requirements: TPSeries(exch='NSE', token=<cash>, interval=5, st=now-15d, et=now) cached once per day per symbol pre-open; today's bars from the live signal history. Slot alignment: Shoonya bar `time` is the bar start in IST — key buckets on the HH:MM of bar start. Skip sessions with <60 bars (half days / data gaps) when building medians. params: N_sessions=10, min_sessions=5, w_bar=0.6, w_cum=0.4, map_points=[(0.5,25),(0.8,45),(1.2,55),(2.0,75),(4.0,90)], aggregate=median.

algorithms.name: Futures OI Regime (long/short buildup 4-quadrant)
algorithms.inputs: Current-month stock FUTURES contract: lp, prev close `c`, oi, prev-day OI `poi` (websocket touchline; fallback below) from GetQuotes/touchline; futures 5m TPSeries bars (intc, intoi) for the last hour; days to futures expiry.
algorithms.steps:
1. Resolve futures token once daily: SearchScrip(exch='NFO', searchtext='<SYMBOL>') -> instrument FUTSTK, nearest (current-month) expiry.
2. DAILY deltas: dP_day = (lp - c)/c; dOI_day = (oi - poi)/poi. If poi unavailable from touchline cache, fallback: poi = intoi of the last 5m bar of the previous trading day from cached futures TPSeries; if that also fails, skip the daily component.
3. INTRADAY deltas over K=12 five-min bars (1 hour): dP_intra = (intc_now - intc_{-12})/intc_{-12}; dOI_intra = (intoi_now - intoi_{-12})/intoi_{-12}. Use fewer bars (min 6) early in the session.
4. Dead zones: price FLAT if |dP| < p_flat (daily 0.10%, intraday 0.10%); OI FLAT if |dOI| < oi_flat (daily 0.5%, intraday 0.3%). Either axis flat -> quadrant = NEUTRAL.
5. 4-quadrant rule: P up & OI up = LONG_BUILDUP (fresh longs, bullish); P down & OI up = SHORT_BUILDUP (fresh shorts, bearish); P up & OI down = SHORT_COVERING (weakly bullish — forced exits, tends to fade); P down & OI down = LONG_UNWINDING (weakly bearish).
6. Base buy scores per quadrant: LONG_BUILDUP 80, SHORT_COVERING 65, NEUTRAL 50, LONG_UNWINDING 35, SHORT_BUILDUP 20. base_sell = 100 - base_buy.
7. Magnitude scale: sf = clamp(|dOI| / oi_ref, 0.5, 1.5) with oi_ref = 2.0% daily, 1.0% intraday. score = 50 + (base - 50)*sf, clamp [10,90]. Compute per timeframe.
8. Blend: buy = w_day*buy_day + w_intra*buy_intra (defaults 0.5/0.5). Expiry distortion guard: if days_to_expiry <= 3 (rollover collapses OI and fakes 'unwinding'), set w_day=0, w_intra=1.0.
9. HONEST CAVEATS (comment in code): OI change cannot tell who initiated (a rising-OI up-move may be hedgers shorting against cash longs); short-covering rallies routinely fail; arbitrage/physical-settlement hedges pollute stock futures OI; Shoonya intoi can update with a small lag vs price — treat this as regime CONTEXT agreeing/disagreeing with the trigger, never a standalone direction call, hence the [10,90] clamp.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: buy = 0.5*[50 + (base_buy(quad_day)-50)*sf_day] + 0.5*[50 + (base_buy(quad_intra)-50)*sf_intra], clamps [10,90] each; w_day forced to 0 within 3 days of expiry; missing futures data -> 50. LONG_BUILDUP/SHORT_COVERING agree with BUY.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Identical structure with base_sell = 100 - base_buy per quadrant: SHORT_BUILDUP (80) and LONG_UNWINDING (65) support SELL.
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.20, sell 0.20 — genuinely orthogonal information (positioning of leveraged players) but classification is coarse and expiry-distorted.
algorithms.data_requirements: Futures token via SearchScrip (daily cache). GetQuotes(exch='NFO', token=<fut>) for lp, c, oi; `poi` from the websocket touchline cache on the futures token (subscribe futures alongside cash), fallback to previous session's last TPSeries intoi. TPSeries(exch='NFO', token=<fut>, interval=5) for intc/intoi — keep a rolling 2-day cache updated by the websocket or a 5-min poller so signal-time scoring reads cache only. If the futures leg is illiquid (day volume < 1 lot*100) or data missing -> 50/50 flag 'no_futures'. params: K_intra=12 (min 6), p_flat=0.10%, oi_flat_day=0.5%, oi_flat_intra=0.3%, oi_ref_day=2.0%, oi_ref_intra=1.0%, sf_clamp=[0.5,1.5], score_clamp=[10,90], w_day=0.5, w_intra=0.5, expiry_guard_days=3, base_buy={LB:80, SC:65, N:50, LU:35, SB:20}.

algorithms.name: Volume Profile (POC / value area) — FUTURE stub
algorithms.inputs: None at present (would need 1-min candles binned into a price-volume histogram to approximate POC/VAH/VAL; 5m/1m OHLCV binning without tick data is too coarse to trust).
algorithms.steps: 1. Stub: return buy=50, sell=50, flag='not_implemented', weight 0. Placeholder spec for later: build a 20-day composite profile by spreading each 1-min bar's intv uniformly across its [intl, inth] range into price bins of width 0.1*ATR14_daily, take POC = max-volume bin, value area = smallest bin set covering 70% of volume; score BUY high when lp is at/just below a high-volume node below VWAP (support), low when lp is in a low-volume node (air pocket). Deferred until tick or at least verified 1-min data quality is available.
algorithms.default_weight: buy 0.0, sell 0.0 — stub; excluded from the family blend until implemented.
algorithms.data_requirements: Future: TPSeries interval=1 over 20 sessions (large fetch — must be cached nightly). Not called today; the agent class exists so the orchestrator wiring and config schema are stable.

notes: Family weight suggestion (normalized within the Volume family, both directions): rel_volume 0.25, vwap 0.25, futures_oi_regime 0.20, pcr 0.15, orderflow 0.15, volume_profile 0.0. All agents return int scores plus a flags list; any agent whose data is unavailable must return exactly 50/50 with a flag rather than raising, so the orchestrator can renormalize weights. Latency budget: pcr, vwap, rel_volume, futures_oi_regime read only cached/pre-fetched data (pure computation, well under 1s); orderflow makes the single fresh GetQuotes call (~100-300ms) and vwap reuses its `ap`/`lp` response. PCR research grounding: Indian OI-based PCR is writer-dominated, so high PCR = put writing = support (bullish lean), the reverse of the naive reading; index neutral band is ~0.8-1.2 with extremes ~<0.7 / >1.3, and single-stock chains are thinner, call-heavy and event-driven, which is why the stock bands are shifted down (neutral ~0.6, extremes 0.3/1.2) and scores are compressed to [20,80] as mild contrarian context. Sources: [NiftyTrader — Nifty Put Call Ratio](https://www.niftytrader.in/nifty-put-call-ratio), [NiftyTrader — PCR Explained](https://www.niftytrader.in/markets/put-call-ratio-pcr-explained-how-to-use/), [Bajaj Finserv — Put Call Ratio](https://www.bajajfinserv.in/put-call-ratio), [Groww — Put Call Ratio](https://groww.in/p/put-call-ratio), [Strike — Put Call Ratio](https://www.strike.money/options/put-call-ratio), [ICFM — OI PCR in the Indian Stock Market](https://www.icfmindia.com/blog/understanding-open-interest-put-call-ratio-oi-pcr-in-the-indian-stock-market). Implementation notes: (1) do not trust TPSeries `intvwap` as session VWAP without per-broker verification — compute cumulative sum(tp*v)/sum(v) and prefer the touchline `ap` field which is the exchange day-average price; (2) rel_volume needs its own 15-day 5m cache since the 200-bar signal history spans only ~2.7 NSE sessions (75 bars/day); (3) subscribe the current-month futures token on the websocket alongside cash so `poi` and intraday OI are always cached; (4) all piecewise maps are simple linear interpolations — one shared interp(points, x) helper covers pcr, rel_volume and vwap.
